ordinary page prose
text: The first page describes a small community library. Its entrance faces the railway station, while the reading room looks over a garden. Members can borrow books for three weeks and renew them online. A separate desk handles historical records and requests from visiting researchers. The renovation added step-free access, adjustable tables, and quieter study spaces upstairs. Opening hours vary by season; the current schedule is printed beside the door. Staff asked residents to suggest activities for next spring, including writing workshops, language exchanges, and an exhibition of local photographs.
